pages.title: CLASSIFIED
pages.text: $(bold)ORSA-UN JOINT ASSESSMENT$()$(br)RE: Projected conditions after orbital destabilization$(br2)A phase forecast, not a calendar; timing depends on preset and config.$(br2)$(italic)Declassified: no one is left to classify things for.$()

pages.title: Phase 0-1
pages.text: $(bold)Phase 0, "The Last Normal Days".$() No immediate effects. Gather resources; prepare underground shelter.$(br2)$(bold)Phase 1, "Twilight".$() The sun visibly shrinks. Frequent rain. Temperatures begin to drop.

pages.title: Phase 2-3
pages.text: $(bold)Phase 2, "Cooling".$() -10°C. Constant rain or snow. Water begins to freeze; vegetation dies.$(br2)$(bold)Phase 3, "The Long Night".$() -25°C. Constant thunderstorms. Lava begins to cool. Fog.

pages.title: Phase 4-5
pages.text: $(bold)Phase 4, "Deep Freeze".$() -45°C. Surface survival lethal. Obsidian freezes, coal ore crystallizes. Dense fog, near darkness.
$(bold)Phase 5, "Eternal Winter".$() -70°C to -120°C. Permanent midnight, whiteout. Nether portals collapse: dimensional lines severed.

pages.title: Phase 6
pages.text: $(bold)Phase 6, "Atmospheric Collapse".$() -120°C to -273°C.$(br2)$(italic)Early:$() extreme blizzard.$(br)$(italic)Mid:$() air thins, wind dies, fog lifts.$(br)$(italic)Late:$() vacuum, stars, silence, sublimating ice. Breathing fails outside sealed, breathable rooms.

pages.title: Recommendations
pages.text: $(li)Base below Y=0; deeper is warmer$(li)Secure heat before Phase 3$(li)Build a Geothermal Core for heat and oxygen$(li)Late Phase 6: a sealed room that Core or Blast Pit oxygen reaches
You are the unluckiest person alive, and the luckiest, because you are alive.$(br2)$(italic)ORSA Science Division. Rooting for you, quietly, from Mars.$()
